visually_similar_generator_audit.selection_definition: Within each 50-image shard, nearest Euclidean mean-RGB regional vector among the 50 source images plus a one-image-shifted duplicate donor list; only the same pool position was excluded, not duplicate underlying identifiers.
visually_similar_generator_audit.conclusion: The generator did not reliably create visually similar cross-image replacements; duplicate source images in the shifted donor pool made most nominal replacements pixel-identical. This is a generator-validity defect in that attack condition, not digest evidence of semantic robustness.

exact_content_integrity.dct_phash: unsupported: lossy digest and benign-tolerance thresholds intentionally ignore many pixel changes
exact_content_integrity.combined_digest: unsupported: lossy digest and benign-tolerance thresholds intentionally ignore many pixel changes

perceptual_integrity.dct_phash: partially supported: benign gates pass, but small overlays and the invalid visually-similar condition prevent the frozen reproduction gates
perceptual_integrity.combined_digest: partially supported and stronger on 25% splice/overlay, but still fails aggregate and overlay gates

semantic_integrity.dct_phash: unsupported: no object, text, identity, or layout representation
semantic_integrity.combined_digest: unsupported: low-frequency hash/statistics do not establish semantic change sensitivity

robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.benign_robustness: robust branch tolerates declared benign processing; fragile branch deliberately does not
robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.similar_replacement_sensitivity: potentially high for pixel changes, but fragile alarms conflate benign processing
robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.registry_storage: two digests per region; likely tens of bytes/region
robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.external_requirement: authenticated registry digest pairs; no original pixels at verification
robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.adversarial_weaknesses: fragile false alarms, robust collisions, digest transplantation
robust_plus_fragile_dual_digest.fixed_20bit_packet: compatible only through registry lookup; not by embedding both digests

canonicalized_cryptographic_hashing.benign_robustness: only to transformations perfectly removed by canonicalization

local_deep_feature_similarity.benign_robustness: potentially strong; must be calibrated independently
local_deep_feature_similarity.similar_replacement_sensitivity: potentially better for semantic differences, uncertain for lookalikes
local_deep_feature_similarity.registry_storage: compressed embeddings commonly tens to hundreds of bytes/region
local_deep_feature_similarity.external_requirement: registry embeddings/model version; no original pixels
local_deep_feature_similarity.adversarial_weaknesses: feature collisions, adversarial examples, model drift
local_deep_feature_similarity.crop_sync: required unless feature mechanism adds localization

semi_fragile_learned_signatures.benign_robustness: learnable but requires real transformation validation
semi_fragile_learned_signatures.fixed_20bit_packet: unknown; extra neural capacity likely required
semi_fragile_learned_signatures.crop_sync: required unless jointly trained for synchronization

object_text_layout_semantic_consistency.registry_storage: structured detections/text/layout may be hundreds to thousands of bytes/image
object_text_layout_semantic_consistency.external_requirement: authenticated registry features and model versions
object_text_layout_semantic_consistency.adversarial_weaknesses: detector/OCR failures, semantic collisions, adversarial content
object_text_layout_semantic_consistency.crop_sync: region correspondence or independent registration required

registry_multiscale_regional_features.benign_robustness: can combine robust coarse and sensitive fine scales
registry_multiscale_regional_features.similar_replacement_sensitivity: testable and likely better than current compact digest
registry_multiscale_regional_features.registry_storage: explicit cost; likely hundreds of bytes/image or more

smallest_next_experiment.recommendation: Replace only the invalid visually-similar generator with a cross-image, SHA-distinct, pixel-different selector; predeclare semantic/perceptual similarity strata using registry-stored multiscale regional features, then evaluate current frozen digests plus one local deep-feature baseline on a new disjoint locked population.
smallest_next_experiment.why_smallest: It directly repairs the measured attack-condition validity defect and tests the current digest-space blind spot without threshold tuning, watermark training, or packet changes.
smallest_next_experiment.prohibitions: Do not reuse the locked reproduction population for selection, do not tune frozen thresholds, and do not interpret feature similarity as cryptographic authentication.
